==''Info''==
When opened for the first time they randomly generate a variety of [[Drops|Parasite Loot]], with the exception of [[:Category:Hijacked Mobs|Hijacked Drops]]. 

When the player is in the interface, red, blood-like particles will spawn from the bottom of the screen and slowly move upwards. This is purely visual. If the player chooses to grab an item, they will take a guaranteed half a heart of damage plus a bonus based on how many of the container's slots are empty. There are three tiers for the Parasite Loot Block, each corresponding for [[Assimilated Mobs]], [[Adapted Parasites]] and [[Nexus Parasites]] items. Breaking them results in all of their drops being deleted with no way to get them back, so do not try this.

To safely extract items from the Loot Blocks without taking damage, one can either siphon the contents out with a hopper, or replace the items taken out with other items. Note that items you are replacing with must be a Scape and Run item, and it can't be anything from vanilla Minecraft or a Scape and Run block.

'''Parasitic Growth Blocks''' can naturally generate in the [[Meteor]] structure or in the [[Nests]] of either a [[Rooter (Disambiguation)|Rooter]] or [[Dispatcher (Disambiguation)|Dispatcher]]. Parasite Loot Blocks may also generate in [[Colony]] Buildings, with an estimated 60% to generate as a common variant, 30% to generate as an uncommon variant, and 10% to generate as a rare variant.

==Effects==

Whenever taking an item from the '''Parasitic Loot''' the following formulas are applied:

*'''Fullness:''' Queries how many slots are free and subtracts the number from 27. Then divides by the total (27 in this case) and multiplies by 1000. The result is a float. The equation is <math>((27-Free)/27)*1000</math>

*'''Damage:''' <math> 0.5F + 7.5F * (1.0F - Fullness)</math>
**Note that the maximum of Fullness is 1 and the minimum is 0. This ultimately results in the game applying at least half a heart of flat parasite damage and at most four hearts of damage.

Additionally, depending on how full the Loot Block is, it will apply stacking [[Viral]] II - IV for five to thirty seconds and [[Corrosion]] I - II for five to twenty seconds. The emptier the Loot Block, the more severe the effects and vice versa.

==''Trivia''==
*The various types of Parasitic Growths, Benign, Malignant, and Metastatic, are all also forms of tumors, hinting at a biological similarity.
